declarations.name: anova_oven_kernel.inv_preserved
declarations.signature:
∀ (s : anova_oven_kernel.State) (c : anova_oven_kernel.Command),
  anova_oven_kernel.Inv s →
    @Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result anova_oven_kernel.State anova_oven_kernel.Error)
      (anova_oven_kernel.transition s c) fun r =>
      ∀ (s' : anova_oven_kernel.State),
        @Eq (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result anova_oven_kernel.State anova_oven_kernel.Error) r
            (@Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok anova_oven_kernel.State anova_oven_kernel.Error s') →
          anova_oven_kernel.Inv s'

declarations.name: anova_oven_kernel.incr_below_limit
declarations.signature:
∀ (s : anova_oven_kernel.State),
  @LT.lt Nat instLTNat (@Aeneas.Std.UScalar.val Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U64 s.count)
      (@Aeneas.Std.UScalar.val Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U64 s.limit) →
    @Aeneas.Std.WP.spec (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result anova_oven_kernel.State anova_oven_kernel.Error)
      (anova_oven_kernel.transition s anova_oven_kernel.Command.Incr) fun r =>
      ∃ s',
        And
          (@Eq (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result anova_oven_kernel.State anova_oven_kernel.Error) r
            (@Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok anova_oven_kernel.State anova_oven_kernel.Error s'))
          (@Eq Nat (@Aeneas.Std.UScalar.val Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U64 s'.count)
            (@HAdd.hAdd Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd Nat instAddNat)
              (@Aeneas.Std.UScalar.val Aeneas.Std.UScalarTy.U64 s.count)
              (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1)))))
